recommendation: Keep this source-changing commit as-is. It is a bounded completion of the existing FHIR-47496 application; no additional core changes are indicated unless the work group later wants a different example focal member or broader PersonalRelationship policy.
issue_request: FHIR-47496 was Applied with a Persuasive with Modification resolution for R6. It requested removing v3 family relationship codes from the Group.member.involvement value set, adding a family-member code, adding a primary-contact/head-of-household code, adding guidance for detailed relationship codings and PersonalRelationship, and adding a Group example that demonstrates the approved pattern.
initial_application: No commit with FHIR-47496 in the subject or trailer was found before reconciliation. Git history showed 191fa02f0491ac1c45c574c4cc95daef019aa472 carried FHIR-47496 inside a multi-issue Group commit and partially applied the value set/code/guidance changes. The earlier family example from 0dd012bbd56a3ca3ed29682ac040c009e2b42be6 still used only v3 RoleCode codings and did not show family-member plus detailed codings or a primary contact.
additional_context: FHIR-I minutes from 2024-11-18 record the 10-0-0 motion and explicitly state that detailed relationship codings should be accompanied by family-member in the same CodeableConcept and scoped by a primary-contact/head-of-household. The FHIR-I Zulip discussion explains why detailed family roles are ambiguous without an explicit focal member. The edited files are current Group source files under an active Group resource folder; source/fhir.ini also has an active group-involvement value set entry.
reconciliation: Changed source/group/codesystem-group-involvement.xml so primary-contact is scoped to family/household groups and family-member is explicitly appropriate for both family and household groups. Changed source/group/group-notes.xml to use a real XHTML link to the Personal Relationship RoleType value set and to say detailed relationship codings and family-member belong in the same Group.member.involvement CodeableConcept. Changed source/group/group-example-family.xml to designate a primary contact and pair each detailed v3 RoleCode coding with family-member.
source_changes: source/group/codesystem-group-involvement.xml: aligned primary-contact and family-member definitions/properties with the approved family/household scope.

source/group/group-notes.xml: clarified that detailed relationship codings and family-member belong in the same Group.member.involvement CodeableConcept and made the Personal Relationship RoleType value set link valid XHTML.
source/group/group-example-family.xml: added primary-contact and family-member codings so the example demonstrates the approved pattern rather than unpaired v3 RoleCode codings.
